title: Senior Product Manager, AI-Driven FinTech Platforms
jd_excerpt:
EY Foundry/Innovation seeks a Product Manager to design, develop, and drive adoption of digital products for external clients. You will lead cross-functional teams, create personas, conduct research, and manage backlogs while shaping long-term strategy. Requires a bachelor’s degree and 5+ years PM experience.

You’ll work in a hybrid EY environment with competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, supporting diverse talents globally.
